sources.title: Identità, Passport Office: Applicable Fees
sources.said: What are the applicable fees for a passport? Passport 16 years and over (Sept to March) €70 Passport 16 years and over (April to Aug) €80 Passport 10-15 years €40 Passport under 10 years €16 ... What are the urgent passport fees? Passport 16 years and over (Sept to March) €160 Passport 16 years and over (April to Aug) €160 Passport 10-15 years €80 Passport under 10 years €60

sources.title: Identità, Passport Office: FAQs
sources.said: For how long will be the validity of my passport? Passport 16 years and over: 10 years Passport 10-15 years: 5 years Passport under 10 years: 2 years

sources.title: Identità, Passport Office: Minors First Time/Renewal – 16 to 17 years
sources.said: In normal circumstances the passport will be ready for collection after 4 working days against a fee of €70 (September to March) or €80 (April to August).
